commands.command: npx vitest run src/data/map/map.data.test.ts src/data/map/map.loader.test.ts src/data/map/map.import.test.ts

verified: Every registered city skeleton passes identity, WGS84, road-class, source-node and water-ring checks.
Overpass query partitions exactly cover each full bbox, including a successfully empty Shenzhen offshore partition.
Invalid HTTP 200 JSON/gzip and timeout-late responses are never handed to the offline worker.
Failed requests retry with cache reload; uncached offline cities receive a specific recovery message.
Validated raw bytes are handed to an acknowledging worker without a second fetch, including a simulated old-worker/new-controller transition.
Decoded memory retains only the two most recent cities; failed loads do not evict successful entries or mutate held map objects.
limitations: Unit and source-data checks only; final rendered-browser acceptance is recorded separately by the root task.
No real-device, field-positioning or coastline-navigation validation.
